description: Coverage ratchet floors (see scripts/pre-commit/check-coverage-ratchet.mjs). Update with --update after intentional coverage gains. Floors are set from a measured run; tolerancePct absorbs measurement jitter AND cross-environment variance (floors are often measured on macOS while CI runs ubuntu-latest). maxHeadroomPct fails the check when a floor sits too far under the measurement, so a later drop cannot land green without a baseline diff.
